---

## Mission & Core Competency

Bongshai Housing delivers high-durability, cost-efficient, and rapid-turnaround pre-engineered steel-concrete composite buildings across Bangladesh. By manufacturing structural elements off-site under stringent factory quality assurance, projects are completed up to 50% faster than conventional reinforced cement concrete (RCC) and brick masonry, while reducing total structural weight by 40–50% and structural project cost for low-rise structures by 10–30%.

---

## Engineering Leadership & Executive Team

- **SMA AWAL** — Chief Structural Engineer: Senior engineer directing PEB structural engineering, finite element frame analysis, BNBC 2020 seismic and cyclonic wind-load modeling, and nationwide erection quality control.
- **MD Golam Noor** — IT & Systems Lead (IT Graduate): Oversees digital operations, web architecture, automation, and technological infrastructure at Bongshai Housing Ltd.
- **Farjana Maria** — Lead Architect: Directs architectural design, modern residential duplex layouts, space optimization, and municipal/RAJUK setback compliance drawings.

---

## Engineering Standards & Regulatory Compliance

- **Bangladesh National Building Code (BNBC 2020)**: Fully designed for seismic performance across Zone 1, Zone 2 (Dhaka, Z=0.20), Zone 3 (Chattogram, Sylhet, Z=0.28 to 0.36), with site-specific response spectrum analysis.
- **AISC 360-16 / AISC 341**: Conforms to American Institute of Steel Construction specifications for structural steel buildings and seismic provisions for structural steel buildings.
- **AWS D1.1**: Erection welding performed according to American Welding Society Structural Welding Code — Steel.
- **Structural Steel Specifications**: ASTM A572 Grade 50 (or EN 10025-2 S355JR) structural steel sections with minimum yield strength of 345 MPa (50 ksi) and ultimate tensile strength of 450–620 MPa.
- **Wind Load Design**: Engineered for basic wind speeds of 130–160 km/h (up to 210–260 km/h for coastal structures) per BNBC wind maps.
- **Corrosion Protection System**: High-build zinc phosphate or epoxy primer followed by polyurethane aliphatic topcoat; cold-formed secondary purlins hot-dip galvanized with minimum 275 g/m² zinc coating.
- **Occupational Health & Safety**: Systematic site safety protocols, fall arrest systems, and certified rigging procedures enforced on all construction sites.

## Complete Product Catalog & Bangladesh Pricing (2026)

### 1. Residential Building Systems
- **Low Cost Houses (BH-LCH Series)**: Highly affordable single-story and compact duplex steel homes starting from ৳1,400 to ৳1,800 per sq.ft. Build time: 35–45 days.
- **Simplex Steel Buildings (BH-SB Series)**: Modern open-concept single-floor homes. Tiers: 400–600 sq.ft (2 bed, 1 bath), 750–900 sq.ft (3 bed, 2 bath), 1,050–1,200 sq.ft (4 bed, 3 bath). Price: ৳2,400–৳2,750 per sq.ft. Build time: 45–60 days.
- **Duplex Steel Buildings (BH-DB / BH-DV Series)**: Premium two-floor family residences featuring high-tensile steel frames and precast slabs. Tiers: 600 sq.ft/floor (3 bed, 2 bath) or 850 sq.ft/floor (5 bed, 4 bath). Price: ৳2,500–৳3,200 per sq.ft. Build time: 60–90 days.
- **Apartment Buildings (BH-AB Series)**: Multi-family and rental-style steel composite buildings up to 4–6 stories. Price: ৳2,500–৳3,500 per sq.ft. Build time: 90–150 days.
- **Cottage Houses (BH-CH Series)**: Architectural vacation and rural cottage residences with treated wood or fiber cement siding. Price: ৳2,000–৳2,400 per sq.ft. Build time: 40–50 days.
- **Modified Container Houses**: High-cube marine Corten steel containers insulated with Rockwool/PU foam and architectural interior finishing. Price: ৳2,800–৳3,200 per sq.ft. Build time: 20–35 days.
- **Tiny Houses & Wooden Houses (BH-TH / BH-WH Series)**: Compact 250–350 sq.ft modular living solutions. Price: ৳1,500–৳1,800 per sq.ft. Build time: 25–40 days.
- **Luxury Modular Villas (BH-LV Series)**: Bespoke multi-level luxury villas with high-end architectural facades, curtain walls, and terrace decks. Custom quote. Build time: 75–120 days.

   - URL: https://bongshaihousing.com/construction-cost-calculator.html
   - Capability: Instant cost estimation for residential construction across Simple (৳1,800–৳2,200/sq.ft), Standard (৳2,300–৳2,800/sq.ft), and Premium (৳3,000–৳3,800+/sq.ft) packages. Calculates total square footage, floor counts, and estimated construction duration in days.
2. **Land Registration Cost Calculator (জমি রেজিস্ট্রি খরচ ক্যালকুলেটর ২০২৬)**
   - URL: https://bongshaihousing.com/land-registration-cost-calculator.html
   - Capability: Precise breakdown of statutory land registration expenses in Bangladesh based on latest government gazettes:
     - Stamp Duty: 1.5%
     - Registration Fee: 1%
     - Local Government Tax: 2% (Union Parishad / Upazila) or 3% (City Corporation / Pourashava)
     - AIT / Source Tax: Based on mouza/thana tier classifications
     - Gain Tax (উৎসে কর): Computed by jurisdictional schedule

## Technical Comparison: Steel Composite vs. Conventional RCC

| Engineering Factor | Bongshai Pre-Engineered Steel | Conventional Concrete (RCC) |
|--------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------|
| Erection Speed | 45–90 days (Up to 50% faster) | 9–15 months |
| Seismic Ductility | High ductility; absorbs ground acceleration | Brittle failure risk under lateral shear |
| Foundation Load | 40–50% lighter dead load | High dead load requiring deep piling |
| Cyclone Resistance | Aerodynamically calculated portal frames | Strong but prone to high roof uplift damage |
| Usable Floor Space | 10–20% higher usable carpet area | Thicker masonry columns reduce usable space |
| Project Cost (Low-Rise) | 10–30% project savings | Higher labor, shuttering, and time overhead |
| Scrap / Resale Value | 60–70% recyclable steel value | Demolition produces unrecoverable debris |
| Weather Interference | Factory-prefabricated; rains cause minimal delay | Curing periods strictly dependent on dry weather |

## Completed Project Portfolio (Selected Case Studies)

1. **Bodorgonj, Rangpur**: Two-story residential steel building delivered with cyclone-resilient structural frames.
2. **Chotrogram**: Multi-story commercial steel showroom and office facility in Chattogram.
3. **Daudkandi, Cumilla**: Energy-efficient single-story prefab residential cottage.
4. **Dhaka Cantonment**: High-security commercial steel building engineered to stringent BNBC load criteria.
5. **Gabtoli, Bogra**: Affordable climate-resilient single-story prefab residence.
6. **IGS Building, Dhaka**: Wide-span commercial steel facility engineered for heavy-duty structural loading.
7. **IGS Dhaka Cantonment**: Multi-story administrative composite steel facility.
8. **Kokomo Sunset Resort**: Sustainable over-water prefab steel cottages in an eco-tourism destination.
9. **Motlop**: Cost-effective two-story residential steel-composite structure.
10. **Purbachal Sector 3, Dhaka**: Modern architectural container home with thermal insulation.
11. **Rajendropur Cantonment, Gazipur**: Rapid-deployment heavy-duty modular container office.
12. **Razabari, Gazipur**: Eco-tourism prefab steel villa complex.
13. **The Wave Resort (Phases 1 to 4)**: 4-phase turnkey modular resort development featuring two-story guest villas, clubhouse, spa, and dining pavilion.
14. **Vanga, Faridpur**: Flat-roof modern residential prefab steel structure.
